description: The HIPP 7855 security processors packaged as part numbers 7855PP4 and 7855PP6 are highly-integrated cryptographic processors capable of performing DES, 3DES, ARC4, AES, MD5, SHA-1 and HMAC at speeds up to half-duplex OC-3. The 7855's on-board DPU processes protocols based on the available hardware algorithms.This currently includes IPv4/IPv6, IPsec, IPPCP and PPTP.
